title: Pipeline Connection Test 8
speaker: Test Run
blurb:
This sermon uses a pretty simple analogy to make a point that's easy to agree with in theory but harder to sit with honestly: showing up isn't the same as growing. The speaker draws on the image of joining a gym, wandering around, admiring the equipment, and never actually working out. It's a funny picture, but the point lands. Spiritual maturity doesn't happen by proximity. It has to be built.

The core challenge here is aimed at anyone who has settled into a comfortable routine of attending church without really engaging their faith. The sermon pushes back on the idea that being present is enough, and calls people to actually exercise what they believe, not just observe it from a distance.

It's a short but honest word, and the kind of thing worth sitting with if you've ever felt like your faith has plateaued or gone a bit stale. Maturity, as the speaker puts it, is built over time. It doesn't just happen to you.

If you're in the Wimmera region, come join us at Harvest Church this Sunday and bring someone along.
